record.title: DeepSeek V4-Pro reaches GA with stronger agent benchmarks and native Responses API support
record.summary: DeepSeek rolled out the GA version of V4-Pro across app, web and API, emphasizing agent-capability upgrades, adjustable reasoning effort and native compatibility with the OpenAI Responses API format.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: DeepSeek V4-Pro GA is available through app, web and API with native Responses API support.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: DeepSeek reports major agent-performance gains across several coding and tool-use benchmarks.

engineering_implications: Responses API compatibility lowers switching cost for agent harnesses and makes controlled cross-provider evaluation easier.

evidence_gaps.description: Independent agent benchmark replication and real production traces are needed.

limitations: Benchmark scores are first-party and the model is hosted/proprietary, limiting architectural auditability.
research_implications: Reasoning-effort control is becoming a standard systems knob for allocating compute dynamically across agent tasks.
brief.summary: DeepSeek rolled out the GA version of V4-Pro across app, web and API, emphasizing agent-capability upgrades, adjustable reasoning effort and native compatibility with the OpenAI Responses API format.

technical.claimed_result: DeepSeek reports strong gains on agent benchmarks including Terminal Bench 2.1, NL2Repo, DeepSWE, Toolathlon-Verified and related suites.
technical.compute_or_cost: Peak/off-peak pricing introduced for the V4 lineup; exact cost-quality Pareto depends on workload and reasoning setting.
technical.demonstrated_result: DeepSeek made V4-Pro GA available on app, web and API and documented the model identifier and API compatibility.
technical.implementation_status: GA on DeepSeek API/app/web; native OpenAI Responses API format documented.
technical.mechanism: Production model update with adjustable reasoning effort, agent-oriented post-training and native Responses API compatibility.
technical.novelty: Combines production agent optimization, adjustable reasoning effort and cross-API compatibility in the GA release.
technical.regime: Hosted proprietary production model for coding, tools and long-horizon agent workflows.
technical.reproducibility: API behavior is externally testable; weights/training internals are not open and benchmark claims require independent confirmation.
technical.strongest_baseline: Earlier DeepSeek V4-Pro/V4 generation and contemporary production agent models.

brief.title: DeepSeek V4-Pro reaches GA with stronger agent benchmarks and native Responses API support
brief.why_it_matters: The release is a meaningful competitive signal for production agent models: it couples reported gains on software/tool benchmarks with API compatibility and variable reasoning effort rather than treating agent capability as a standalone benchmark feature.
